Class mainView

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
gui.mainView
public class mainView extends javafx.application.Application
Main JavaFX GUI for the Remote Control application. Features: - 2xN button grid layout - Edit Commands and Open Debug buttons - Undo/Redo functionality - Dark theme with external CSS
